capabilities: Read all daily entries on one page
Switch between infinite scroll and book modes
Show an activity heatmap of entries
Display life-area tags with signal meters
View entries as a list or grid of cards
extras: Read-only: nothing on the page can be edited; open a note to edit it. Expects files named 'DD-MM-YYYY - Journal.md'. AI features (titles, highlights, focus tags, and Chat/Compare/Regenerate/Summarize actions) come from the separate Journal Scroll Assistant plugin. Beta builds are available via BRAT.
problem: Reading through daily journal entries normally requires opening each note separately, with no continuous or book-like reading view.

relations.evidence: Actions at the end of each day (with Journal Scroll Assistant installed)
install Obsidian42 - BRAT, choose Add a beta plugin

summary: Read-only journal viewer that shows all daily entries as one continuous scroll or a page-by-page book, opening at today.
